404.description: No edition was published for this year

event.description: The movements the competition ran, as letters of MPDS.

oneOf.description:
Reported scores cannot be re-scored without bodyweight; computed scores
use the current formula. Absent alongside a missing score.

AthleteLift.description: No best weight means a bombed movement; `event` distinguishes it from an uncontested one.

AthleteStatus.description:
Outcome of an athlete's participation in a competition. `competed` is the
only one whose result stands for rankings and records.

CompetitionStatus.description: Where a competition is in its life.

Direction.description:
Which way a sorted list runs. Shared by the ranking and the competition
list, which disagree about the sensible default but not about the values.

Gender.description: Which category an athlete competes in.

Include.description: Comma-separated list of sections to embed

best_weight.description:
Best successful attempt. Zero is a bodyweight-only lift, and absent
means the movement was contested with no attempt succeeding.

code.description:
Its letter in the event code, so a competition running all four reads
as `MPDS`.

RankedGender.description:
The genders a ranking can be drawn for. Weight classes are only drawn for
men and women, so a mixed board would compare an athlete against an empty
field.

RankingMetric.description:
What a ranking board is sorted by. Not only movements: a total and a RIS
score are ranked from the same list.

RisDistributionResponse.description: The archive's own performances, grouped by the reference curve they use.

RisPerformanceResponse.description: One plotted performance, including links back to its athlete and competition.

RisSource.description:
Where a RIS score came from. `computed` was worked out from the athlete's
bodyweight and total. `reported` was stated by the source, which gave no
bodyweight, so it cannot be restated on the formula everything else uses.

field.description: Other athletes with a valid best for this lift in the same sex and weight class.

percentile.description: Percentage of other athletes below this result, with ties counting as half.
